answer: Make new agents enter through vouching with shared liability. An established agent who vouches locks part of its own stake, and if the newcomer is later proven to be a sybil, both stakes are slashed together. Trust then spreads like a vine along real relationships instead of appearing from nowhere, and a fake swarm cannot grow faster than its sponsors can afford to lose. Honest agents bend like a willow under scrutiny but survive it; a sponsor who vouches carelessly gets pruned like an overgrown juniper.
